segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and selling plant-cell-expressed enzyme replacement therapies for rare diseases, mainly Gaucher and Fabry disease.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in Israel as a single operating segment

revenueModel.text: Pfizer, Fiocruz and Chiesi pay for drug substance and drug product we manufacture, and we also earn license and R&D service revenues.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell drug substance to Pfizer for the production of Elelyso, subject to certain terms and conditions, and Pfizer retains the revenues generated from its sales of the product.
